entries.title: Syntax or parse error
entries.description: The source cannot be parsed according to the language grammar.

entries.title: Symbol resolution error
entries.description: A name, symbol, member, field, function, variable, module item, or declaration cannot be resolved.

entries.title: Type error
entries.description: A value, expression, declaration, signature, assignment, or call violates the language type system.

entries.title: Module or package error
entries.description: A module, package, namespace, crate, assembly, or import unit cannot be loaded or compiled correctly.

entries.title: Import or include error
entries.description: An import, include, using directive, dependency path, or header cannot be resolved.

entries.title: Dependency error
entries.description: A package, crate, module, library, gem, wheel, jar, assembly, or version constraint is missing or invalid.

entries.title: Effect declaration error
entries.description: Code performs an effect that is undeclared, unavailable, forbidden, or not permitted by policy.

entries.title: Permission or capability error
entries.description: The tool or program lacks a required permission, capability, environment value, credential, or resource.

entries.title: Memory safety or allocation error
entries.description: A diagnostic about memory safety, allocation, deallocation, bounds, aliasing, raw pointers, or unsafe memory use.

entries.title: Concurrency error
entries.description: A diagnostic about threads, async tasks, data races, locks, channels, cancellation, atomics, or synchronization.

entries.title: Lifetime error
entries.description: A diagnostic about lifetimes, scopes, escaping references, borrowed values, or temporal validity.

entries.title: Ownership or move error
entries.description: A diagnostic about ownership, moves, borrowing, aliasing, or resource ownership transfer.

entries.title: Trait, protocol, or typeclass error
entries.description: A trait, protocol, interface constraint, extension, typeclass, or generic bound is not satisfied.

entries.title: Interface or API contract error
entries.description: A class, struct, object, service, module, or function does not satisfy an expected interface or API contract.

entries.title: Contract or invariant error
entries.description: A precondition, postcondition, invariant, assertion, schema, or refinement contract is violated.

entries.title: Lint finding
entries.description: A linter, analyzer, style checker, or quality rule reported an issue.

entries.title: Formatting issue
entries.description: A formatter or style tool found that source formatting differs from project configuration.

entries.title: Test failure
entries.description: A unit, integration, property, snapshot, doctest, or project test failed.

entries.title: Build error
entries.description: A build, link, package, generated-code, build-script, or artifact production step failed.

entries.title: Runtime error
entries.description: A failure observed while executing code rather than statically checking it.

entries.title: Security finding
entries.description: A security analyzer, policy, dependency scanner, or compiler security check reported a risk.

entries.title: Performance finding
entries.description: A diagnostic about performance, allocation, optimization, escape analysis, inlining, or inefficient code.

entries.title: Configuration error
entries.description: A tool, compiler, project, manifest, environment, plugin, or configuration file is invalid.

entries.title: Documentation issue
entries.description: A documentation comment, doc test, generated documentation, public API doc rule, or doc format issue.

entries.title: Unknown diagnostic kind
entries.description: The adapter cannot classify the diagnostic reliably.
